dos.text: Treat this as a thin wrapper around the native color input rather than a full moz-input-* control, MozInputColor doesn't extend MozBaseInputElement and only declares value, name, and label, so disabled, description, and support-page from sibling inputs simply don't exist here.

donts.text: Don't pass a non-hex or invalid value expecting the component to validate or normalize it, MozInputColor binds .value straight to the native <input type="color"> with no validation of its own, so whatever the browser does with a bad value is all you get.
